SPECIFIC SERVICES

Find the task that fits.

01

Flagpole maintenance

Coordinate maintenance around flag condition, operating hardware and the practical needs of your property.

EXPLORE02

Halyard & rope replacement

The halyard is the rope or cable used to raise and lower a flag. The replacement must suit the pole and its operating mechanism.

EXPLORE03

Flagpole hardware repair

Request help with clips, cleats, finials, pulleys and other hardware that supports the display.

EXPLORE04

Flagpole inspection

Arrange a review of visible pole condition, flag attachments and operating hardware to identify appropriate next steps.

EXPLORE05

Half-mast & flag raising service

Request raising, lowering or half-mast support around your organization’s approved instructions and schedule.

EXPLORE06

Stuck flag & jammed halyard

Describe a flag that will not raise or lower so the operating system and access needs can be assessed.

EXPLORE07

Flagpole noise assessment

Request a review of recurring rope or hardware noise around an occupied property.

EXPLORE08

Flagpole pulley & truck replacement

Discuss worn or damaged pole-top hardware and the access required for a compatible replacement.

EXPLORE09

Post-storm flagpole assessment

Request a review of visible flag, rope or hardware damage following severe weather.

EXPLORE10

Seasonal flag change service

Coordinate a scheduled flag change around your property’s calendar, access and approved designs.

EXPLORE11

Event flag setup & takedown

Request a coordinated flag display setup and removal plan for your event venue.
